title: Skin Care for Runners in India: Sun, Sweat, Smog and Winter Runs
ex: Sunscreen, sweat, cold wind and smoggy mornings: a simple before-and-after routine and a race day checklist for runners in India.
rt: Skin Care for Runners in India: Simple Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for runners in India: sunscreen for morning runs, rinsing off sweat, smoggy winter mornings, a light routine and a race day checklist for marathons.
quick: Runners in India should wear SPF 30+ sunscreen on any run that ends after sunrise, rinse sweat off within about 30 minutes, and use a light moisturiser and lip balm for cold, dry mornings. On very smoggy days, run indoors and cleanse well at night.
